subject.title: [Feature]: Self-hosted STT/TTS provider support in webchat (Route webchat TTS through the gateway instead of browser Speech API)

question: Should this issue remain the broad canonical tracker while TTS Read aloud and editable provider-backed dictation land as separate narrower PRs?
rationale: Current code has overlapping voice surfaces, and choosing between batch dictation, transcription-only Talk, realtime Talk, and TTS settings affects UX, provider routing, authorization, and security boundaries.

options.title: Keep broad tracker and split fixes
options.body: Keep this issue open, review the Read aloud PR for the TTS half, and route editable dictation through the narrower Control UI dictation issue and PR.

options.title: Narrow this issue to TTS
options.body: Retitle or rescope this issue around Gateway-backed Read aloud and make the editable dictation issue the canonical STT tracker.

options.title: Reframe as unified Talk redesign
options.body: Treat this as a larger WebChat voice-mode redesign and pause autonomous implementation until maintainers define the desired UX.

recommendation.title: Keep broad tracker and split fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, review the Read aloud PR for the TTS half, and route editable dictation through the narrower Control UI dictation issue and PR.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from prior WebChat dictation work, speech provider work, recent chat UI history, and the open Read aloud candidate.
